directives.title: Enough Already
directives.description:
This new Spanish Civil War has waged relentlessly for months and we have bled much for the Republic. What did we receive in compensation beyond empty promises and exploitation?

That stops now. Andalucia will be free and the Republic's freedom has shown it is little better than the Caudillo's. Our only option then shall be to make our own freedom, and guarantee our voice is heard.

directives.title: Create CAMA
directives.description:
With our new Republic established, we need to ensure that we can defend our borders against those that would try to take our young state from us. Our remnant land forces are not sufficient to face any serious attack.

Therefore we will create a naval arm of our military, the Cuerpos Auxiliares de Mar, and an air force, the Cuerpos Auxiliares del Aire. Together, our Cuerpos Auxiliares de Mar y Aire will be able to protect Andalucia from wherever our enemies will appear.

directives.title: Defend the Beaches
directives.description:
Currently, the War that rages across the peninsula traps the factions in grueling land warfare. This means that naval combat is few and far between, thanks to the high cost of combat capable ships.

However, this war will not last forever. When the War ends and the victor turns to us, we must acknowledge the possibility that they can attack from the sea as well as land. We will create a series of defenses that any seaborne invader will crash into, with terrible results.

directives.title: Watch the Skies
directives.description:
We want no part of the War, but those fighting seem to care little for our neutrality. In particular, the enemies of the Republic refuse to accept our new position and sometimes continue their attacks on our territory.

We will invest in more anti-air installations to make sure our cities are safe and make sure any attacking aircraft are informed of our neutrality, with extreme prejudice

directives.title: Ships in the Ports
directives.description: We may not be creating a huge navy, however we still need to repair our merchant marine's losses and make sure we can service our fleet. After all, the ports will be vital for our military and economic prosperity in the future. Therefore, we shall allocate funds to expand the ports at Cádiz, Sevilla and Málaga.

directives.title: Men in the Docks
directives.description: Our current Navy is, for lack of a better word, insufficient. Luckily, we boast some of the best ports in the south of the Iberian Peninsula. It is time we put them to wor increasing our naval production so this new republic of ours can trade however we it may like and protect its shores.

directives.title: Andalusians in the Sky
directives.description: No matter how many Anti-Air guns we point at the north, it is inevitable that some planes will be able to slip past our shield. In order to avoid any tragedies we will focus on training a core of combat fighters capable of protecting our skies. What they will lack in numbers they will make up for with Andalusian skill.

directives.title: Restart the Country
directives.description:
Predictably, many of the individuals who made up the previous administration in Andalusia on behalf of the Republic continue to stand with the Republic. They are leaving their posts en masse, leaving large holes in our government that may threaten our ability to function.

We shall commit time and resources to overhauling our administration, cutting out the inefficiencies of old and recruiting new, loyal civil servants. With some effort we may be able to turn this problem into a great opportunity.

directives.title: A Permanent Transition
directives.description: Now that the Republic no longer occupies our lands, we should turn our attention towards improving our infrastructure. Our railroad infrastructure is in dire need of reorganization and investment, therefore we will create the "Red Andaluza de Ferrocarriles", a state company that will allow us the oversight we need. With all our network centralized under the RAF we can begin to modernize our young country yet more.

directives.title: The Heart of a New Economy
directives.title_en: The Heart of a New Economy
directives.description: Inevitably our separation from Spain has caused a great deal of financial disruption, both for the Government and our citizens. Therefore we shall create a new central bank for Andalusia so that we can begin to stabilize our economy and begin our recovery as fast as possible.
directives.description_en: Inevitably our separation from Spain has caused a great deal of financial disruption, both for the Government and our citizens. Therefore we shall create a new central bank for Andalusia so that we can begin to stabilize our economy and begin our recovery as fast as possible.

directives.title: Provisional Representation
directives.description:
The simple reality of our situation is that elections are impossible until such a time as our internal and Iberian situation has stabilized. However many towns across Andalusia still operate under the legislation of the old Republic. Therefore we will begin swapping out incumbent Republican Mayors, Councillors and all those who would seek to damage our young nation in lieu of an election.

These new provisional local leaders will provide us with the foundation with which to move forward.

directives.title: Draft a Constitution
directives.description:
There are still those who question the legitimacy of our new nation, therefore we shall begin drafting a new provisional constitution for Andalusia, highlighting both our right to sovereignty and the rights of Andalusians. For the moment however we shall create a more streamlined, simple document.

We can worry about a more comprehensive Constitution once the chaos of the peninsula begins to ebb.

directives.title: Militant Democracy
directives.description:
All Iberia languished for years under those who were opposed to the will of the people, and it is unfortunate that some people were influenced by such autocracy. Even now, after the bloodshed of the Civil War and our separation from Spain there are those who are opposed to our new nation and its democracy.

To counter this we must make the people understand that they are the first line of defense against anti-democratic subversives. We will run a campaign encouraging our people to be ever vigilant against those who would seek to undermine our nation.

directives.title: Accomodate Everyone
directives.description:
For years Iberia has been gripped by authoritarians and those with more regard for power than humanity. The Republic started with noble ideas but they proved themselves little better than those that came before them. Now, the torch of liberty is passed to us.

We must ensure that we become the beacon of light our people have always desired. All will be welcome in Andalucia, all we ask is that they join us in committing to Democracy. In return, we will make a nation where all Andalucians can be heard.

directives.title: Create FAA
directives.description:
Despite not wishing to involve ourselves in the chaos of the Spanish War, it would be foolish of us to be defenseless. We can not trust that those embroiled in the War do not have designs upon our new nation after all.

We will reorganize our army into the Fuerzas de Autodefensa Andaluzas. To avoid provoking those around us we will focus on a defensive doctrine. This will also allow us to ensure that any who try to take our freedom will pay a dear price.

directives.title: Not a Step Forwards...
directives.description: Having finally gained freedom for ourselves, we have no interest in subjugating any others on this peninsula. Andalusian blood will no longer be spilled in fields that are not theirs. Our army will mirror this, with a new doctrine prioritizing discipline and cohesion in the face of an aggressor, rather than aggression.
directives.description_en: Having finally gained freedom for ourselves, we have no interest in subjugating any others on this peninsula. Andalusian blood will no longer be spilled in fields that are not theirs. Our army will mirror this, with a new doctrine prioritizing discipline and cohesion in the face of an aggressor, rather than aggression.

directives.title: ...Nor Backwards
directives.description:
While we may harbor no imperialist designs of our own, we would be foolish to assume that were true of others. Our troops will be trained in primarily defensive tactics and how to rapidly move to weakened areas to reinforce defenses, with the goal of making them a wall of men more tenacious than any stone or metal barrier.

With the greatest defensive force on the peninsula, any aggressor will not get far should they seek to subjugate us again.

directives.title: Only the Bravest Men..
directives.description:
The legacy of the Spanish War and its conscription requirements has led to many of our citizens being wary of enlisting with our new forces. However, as much as we do not want to maintain a large offensive army, even our defense force requires men.

Since a return to conscription would be completely unacceptable to our people, we shall invest in a new campaign to recruit new Andalucian volunteers. Our military will be made up of those only who genuinely love Andalucia and all we stand for.

directives.title: Only The Best Weapons..
directives.description: That we do not have the same industrial capabilities as most other nations in Europe is beyond doubt, an unfortunate fact given both our small size and youth as a state. Therefore, in order to ensure the proper equipment of our soldiers we shall have to guarantee there will be as few defects as possible in the equipment they are given. This should greatly reduce the strain the military has on our burgeoning industry, as well as losses on general maintenance, allowing vital time and resources to go towards other projects.

directives.title: ...For Only the Most Just Cause
directives.description:
While we are a young country with lots of promise, we cannot forget the fact that we are small. Every building destroyed and every piece of ground lost is something that we will feel grievously. Every step back deprives us of the means to hold fast more and more.

However, we are fighting in our own territory. We know this land. We will take steps to make sure that our defenses are strong while also minimizing the destruction any conflict will inflict on our land.

directives.title: This Is Not Our War
directives.description:
Many in our young state remain uncertain on how we stand on the War gripping the peninsula. This confusion has not been helped by the deployment of our new armed forces, something which has left some to suggest we are preparing to once more enter the fray.

We will sponsor a campaign to make it utterly clear across the country that the Spanish War is not our war, and no more Andalucian blood will be shed for anything other than Andalucia itself.
